1. Mounting PermissionProvider

 Mount `PermissionProvider` at the root of your application. Supply the authorization check function (`userHasPermission`) and the user's active session metadata (`userContext`).

7. Multi-Tenant Hook: useAccessibleOrgs

 Use `useAccessibleOrgs` to query the user's alternative organizations in parallel and populate an organization switcher on 403 error pages.

Component API & Props

Base Component Permission Props

Components including `Button`, `IconButton`, `MenuItem`, `ListItem`, and `ListItemButton` accept the following props: | Prop | Type | Default | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `permissionKey` | `PermissionKeySpec` | `undefined` | Key or key set. When omitted, the component renders normally. | | `permissionAction` | `'showShield' \| 'hide'` | `'showShield'` | When unauthorized, `'showShield'` attaches `PermissionShield` and `'hide'` renders `null`. |

PermissionShieldProps

| Prop | Type | Default | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `permissionKey` | `PermissionKeySpec` | _required_ | Single `Key` or `{ anyOf: Key[] }` / `{ allOf: Key[] }` set. | | `children` | `React.ReactNode` | _required_ | The affordance to guard. | | `variant` | `'inline' \| 'badge'` | `'inline'` | Visual placement of the shield trigger icon. |

PermissionSessionContextProps

| Prop | Type | Default | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `variant` | `'tooltip' \| 'card'` | `'tooltip'` | Visual theme and sizing variant. | | `permissionKey` | `PermissionKeySpec` | `undefined` | Self-resolving key or key set. | | `displayedKeys` | `Key[]` | `undefined` | Pre-resolved array of keys to render. | | `subtitle` | `string` | `undefined` | Custom requirement subtitle. | | `categories` | `string[]` | `undefined` | Category chip labels. | | `subcategories` | `string[]` | `undefined` | Subcategory chip labels. |

PermissionProviderProps

| Prop | Type | Default | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `userHasPermission` | `(key: Key) => boolean` | _required_ | Authorization evaluator function. | | `userContext` | `PermissionUserContext` | `undefined` | Session metadata: `{ userName, orgName, roleNames }`. | | `children` | `React.ReactNode` | _required_ | Root application sub-tree. |
